## Scope check

Stellamem is in **Alpha** and prioritises reliability over breadth. Please note
whether your request is:

- [ ] A reliability / correctness fix
- [ ] A retrieval quality improvement
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] A larger feature (likely Roadmap, may not be implemented soon)

> See [`ROADMAP.md`](../../ROADMAP.md) before proposing large features.
